method: **To make the Puri:** Mix rava, maida, 1 tsp oil, and a pinch of salt. Knead into a firm dough with a little water. Roll out into a large thin circle and cut into small 1.5-inch diameter rounds. Deep fry in hot oil until they puff up and turn golden and crispy.
**To make the Pani:** Grind the mint leaves, green chilies, and ginger into a fine paste. Mix this with 1 liter of water. Add 1 tsp lemon juice, sugar, and salt to taste. Mix well.
**To make the Sweet Chutney:** Combine tamarind extract, chili powder, salt, and jaggery powder. Stir until the jaggery is dissolved and the mixture is well-combined.

**To serve:** Boiled the moong dal until soft but not mushy. Poke a hole in the center of a puri, fill it with a little boiled moong dal, add a little sweet chutney, and dip it into the spiced pani water. Serve immediately.
